verdict: Leads are flowing through Meta; Google spend is being restructured now.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 145 leads at a blended cost of $17.68 per lead — but that number is inflated by Google Ads, which spent $1,074 and produced zero leads over the full period. Meta carried all 145 leads on its own at a true cost of $10.28 per lead. Last week saw a dip in volume, driven by a brief low-activity window mid-week; the three most recent days show spending and lead flow recovering. Google's budget is being reallocated or restructured this period so that spend works as hard as Meta's already does.

watch_item.issue: Google Ads has spent $1,074 over 28 days with no leads to show for it.
watch_item.fix: That budget is being restructured this period; offline conversion tracking goes live by end of September so Google can optimize against real outcomes going forward.
